payload.title: Review editorial work and reference priming in one newsroom
payload.description:
Feature: Unified Papyrus review
Scenario: Advance editorial work
Given an explicitly synthetic newsroom backed by Kanbus
When I open the board, select a story, and advance its stage
Then the actual Kanbus service persists the change across reload
Scenario: Curate representative examples
Given the References view shares the same newsroom navigation
When I preview, revise, label, and accept a synthetic reference
Then the actual Cyclotron priming service stores the example and human labels
Scenario: Safe LAN review
Given the preview is reachable on the private LAN
When a cross-origin write or real source URL is submitted
Then it is refused and no production system is contacted
